paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khe ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang ahia na hon lamsak ding uh? Koi lai ahia ka khawlna ding?
heading: TOUPA'N Namte Vai Ahawm
english: Yahweh says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

paite: Hiai thil bangkim lah ka khut a ka bawl ahi ngal ua, huchi in hiai thil bangkim ahong omta ahi, TOUPA'N achi; himahleh hiai mi gentheitak a om, lungsim a kisik tuntun, ka thu a ling zel zaw ka en zaw ding.
english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

paite: "Bawngtal goumi zaw mi that bang ahi a; belam a kithoihmi zaw ui ngawng hektan bang ahi; thilpiak lanmi peuhmah vok sisan lanmi bang ahi a; begaw halmi peuhmah milim vualzawlmi bang ahi; ahi, amau lampi atelta ua, athilkihhuaite uah alungsim uh akipak zel hi.
english: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

paite: Ka sap lai a kuama'n ahon dawn louh ua, thu ka gen lai a bil a azak louh ua, ka mitmuh a thil gilou ahih zawk ua, ka thil kipahpih louh lam atel ziak un ke'n leng amau khemna dingte ka telsak ding a, akihtak lam uh atung uah ka tungsak ding," chi in.
english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

paite: Athu a lingte aw, TOUPA thu za un; na unau uh, nou hon hopa leh ka min ziak a nou hon delhkhete'n, "Na kipahman uh ka muhtheihna ding un, TOUPA hih thupi in om hen," achi ua, himahleh azum zawta ding uh.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let Yahweh be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

paite: Tua! Khopi a lum vengvung husa! Tempul a kipan husa! Amelmate thukpa TOUPA husa ei ve!
english: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.

paite: "Ama'n vei man lou in nau anei a; na sa man lou in pasal naupang anei hi.
english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

paite: Huchibang kua'n za ngei ahia? Huchibang kua ahia mu ngei? Ni khat in gam apiang guih ding a hia? Thakhat in nam suan in a-om guih ding a hia? Zion in nau aveitak in tate anei pah hi.
english: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.

paite: Pian hun tungsak ngal in ka nei kei ding a hia?" TOUPA'N achi, "Kei neisak zelpa'n ta ka neisak phal kei ding a hia?" Na Pathian in achi hi.
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says Yahweh. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

paite: "Jerusalem itte tengteng aw, Jerusalem nopsakpih unla, kipahpih un; amah suunte tengteng aw, kipah ziak in nuamsakpih un.
english: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

paite: Na tep ua, alungmuanna nawite a na taitheihna ding un leh, na tep peng ua, athupina tampi a na kipahtheihna ding un," chih.
english: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, "Ngai un, luipi bang mai in akiang pha in lemna ka luangsak ding a, nam chih thupina luita akuang a let zoizoi bang mai in akiang pha in ka luangsak ding, huchi in huai na tep ding uh; ahon angpom ding a, apheipi tung ah ahon tawmsak ding hi.
english: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

paite: "Mi, anu'n alungmuan bang in ka hon lungmuan ding; huchi in Jerusalem ah lungmuan in na om ding uhi.
english: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

paite: Huai na mu ding ua, na lungtang un nuam asa ding a, na guhte uh leng loupa hing dipdip bang in apha lihliah ding; huchi in TOUPA khut asikhate lam ah a-om chih athei ding ua, amelmate tung ah alungkim kei ding.
english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

paite: "Ngai un, ahehna thangpaihna a thuk ding leh asalhna meikuang a thuk ding in TOUPA mei toh ahong pai ding hi, akangtalaite pingpei bang mai ahi ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

paite: Mei in ahi, TOUPA'N angaihtuah ding, anamsau in ahi mi tengteng angaihtuah ding; huchi in TOUPA hihlupte zaw tampi ahi ding uh.
english: For Yahweh will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by Yahweh will be many.

paite: "Huante ah ahoh ua, alai a mi nung a om khepkhup ding a kihihsiangthou leh kisiangsak zelte, voksa leh thilkihhuai leh chikpi nete, amangthangkhawm ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.

paite: “Athilhihte uleh angaihtuahte uh lah ka thei ngal a; nam chih leh pau chih ka pikhawm hun ahong tung sin; huchi in ahong pai ding ua, ka thupina amu ding uh.
english: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

paite: Huan alak uah chiamtehna ka omsak ding a, huchi in alak ua gawtna pelte peuhmah namte kiang ah Tarshishte, Pulte, thangpeulaite Lud kiang ah, tuikulh gam gamlapi, ka minthanna za ngei nai lou Tubalte leh Javante kiang ah, ka thupina mu ngei nailoute kiangte ah ka sawl ding; huchi in nam chih lak ah ka thupina thu agen ding uh.
english: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

paite: Huchi in Israel telte'n athillat uh belsuan siangthoutak a TOUPA' inn a ahong lut zel bang un, TOUPA kiang a thillat ding in nam chih teng lak a kipan na unaute tengteng uh sakol tung, kangtalaite, zawnnate, sabiltung tungte, sangawngsau tungte ah, Jerusalem ka tang siangthou ah ahon pi ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to Yahweh, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahweh, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into Yahweh’s house.

paite: "Huan huaite lak a kipan in siampu dingte leh Levi mi dingte ka la ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Ka bawl ding van thakte leh lei thak ka ma ah om gige ding bang in, na suante uh leh na min uh leng a-om gige ding ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says Yahweh, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, kha thak a kipan kha thak dang tan in, Sabbath ni a kipan Sabbath dang tan in mi tengteng ka ma a hon be ding in ahong pai zungzung ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Apaikhe ding ua, ka tung a talekte luang a-en ding uh; athante uh asi kei ding a, ameikuangte uh leng thah in a-om sam kei ding hi; mi tengteng a ding in thilkihhuai mahmah ahi ding uh.”
english: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
